description: TrackerBlockingVpnService restarts its tunnel while the service keeps running, e.g. after a reconfiguration, a network change or a VPN feature being toggled. Sampled at 10% of restarts.

name.description: The name of the application sending the event

version.description: The version of the app when the event's flow started. Release builds are X.Y.Z; internal and nightly builds append the build number and channel suffix.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the current device

dev_mode.description: Whether the app is a debug build

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

type.description: The type of software sending the event

sample_rate.description: Sample rate for this event, between 0 and 1

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first event completed with this feature name and status in the current UTC calendar day

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The terminal status of the flow

restart_mode.description: in_place when the running tunnel is swapped under the live service (restartInPlace toggle on), legacy when the service tears the network stack down and rebuilds it behind a null-route tunnel

network_stack.description: Network stack the restart brings up: the running one, or the new one when a VPN feature was toggled on or off

failure_reason.description: Phase that failed. Only present on FAILURE events.

restart_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Duration of the whole restart, from the restart request until the network stack is running on the new tunnel, in milliseconds, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary

network_stack_prepare_duration_ms_bucket.description: Duration of preparing the network stack configuration (for NetP this includes registration and port probing), in milliseconds, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary

tunnel_establish_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Duration of establishing the new TUN interface and waiting for it to come up, in milliseconds, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary

network_stack_switch_duration_ms_buckete.description: Duration of stopping the running network stack (and destroying and recreating it on the legacy path), in milliseconds, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary

network_stack_start_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Duration of starting the network stack on the new tunnel, in milliseconds, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary

step.network_stack_prepare.description: Parameter present if the network stack configuration was prepared successfully

step.tunnel_establish.description: Parameter present if the new TUN interface was established successfully

step.network_stack_switch.description: Parameter present if the running network stack was stopped (and replaced) successfully

step.network_stack_start.description: Parameter present if the network stack started on the new tunnel successfully
